graph.mask_method: intermediate GSHHG L1 polygons intersect fine-grid centers; polygon boundaries are land

graph.aggregation: separate four-connected sea components inside each block
graph.conductance_scope: topology is preserved; aggregation is not an exact circuit reduction

limits: Only channels resolved by the declared fine grid are retained; no inferred bridges are added.
Fine-grid center adjacency can miss coastline features narrower than the fine resolution.
Topology is preserved on aggregation, but effective resistance is not an exact fine-circuit reduction.
Island terminals and biological comparisons have not been evaluated by this topology builder.

original_grid.source_original_pyramid_resampling_metho: not supplied; average of overview values only

derived_grid.resampling: GDAL geographic area-overlap average of explicitly extracted 0.01-degree overview; source NoData excluded
derived_grid.fixed_alignment: Exactly 0.5-degree cells: west=-180, north=85, east=180, south=-85
derived_grid.input_to_resampling: Original extracted 0.01-degree overview, never an interpolation of a previously derived coarse grid

AIS_source_receipt.note: Coarse global raster for exploratory AIS-weighted marine resistance, not a direct voyage graph or measured propagule flux.

wind_source_receipt.wind_speed_proxy: Arithmetic monthly mean of magnitude of each monthly averaged U,V; NOT raw 6-hourly wind speed mean
caveats: NOAA NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1 (public), NOT NASA MERRA-2 or ERA5.
A 10m monthly vector-mean speed cannot represent individual butterfly flight altitude, flight season or transoceanic tailwind events.
Undirected scalar conductance loses true wind vector transport direction.
Interpolated NOAA ~2 degree climatology onto 1 degree output does not create new observed fine-scale wind resolution.
2015–2021 modern mean winds cannot explain the actual dates of historic nonnative plant introductions.

wind_regridding: repeat each observed1-degree parent over four0.5-degree children; no new observed resolution
